caveats.statement: posts.CreaionDate is misspelled (missing 't'); queries using CreationDate on posts will fail.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE CreaionDate IS NOT NULL;

caveats.statement: Some posts have NULL OwnerUserId (e.g. Community-owned), so joins to users may drop rows.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE OwnerUserId IS NULL;

caveats.statement: users.Age is often NULL, so Age > 65 filters exclude many users.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE Age IS NULL;

caveats.statement: posts.ClosedDate NULL means the post is still open; non-NULL means closed.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE ClosedDate IS NULL;

caveats.statement: votes.BountyAmount is NULL for non-bounty votes; filtering BountyAmount=50 only matches bounty votes.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes WHERE BountyAmount IS NULL;

caveats.statement: comments.UserId may not match users.Id for deleted users; use UserDisplayName as fallback.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.Id IS NULL;

caveats.statement: badges.Name is case-sensitive; 'Autobiographer' vs 'autobiographer' may differ.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Name FROM badges WHERE LOWER(Name) = 'autobiographer';

caveats.statement: posts.Title may contain special characters; use LIKE with wildcards for partial matches.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE Title LIKE '%variance%';

derived.name: ElderUserPostCount
derived.definition: Number of posts owned by users older than 65.

derived.name: UsersWithManyBadges
derived.definition: Number of users awarded more than 5 badges.

derived.name: AvgPostScorePerUser
derived.definition: Average score of posts owned by a given user.

derived.name: PctPostsByHighRepUsers2011
derived.definition: Percentage of 2011 posts whose owners had reputation > 1000.
aliases: percentage of posts by high reputation users in 2011
derived.formula: COUNT(Post.Id WHERE YEAR(PostCreationDate)=2011 AND UserReputation>1000) / COUNT(Post.Id WHERE YEAR(PostCreationDate)=2011) * 100

derived.name: PctRPostsByCommunity
derived.definition: Percentage of Community-owned posts tagged with R.
aliases: percentage of R posts by Community
derived.formula: COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostTag='r' AND User.DisplayName='Community') / COUNT(Post.Id WHERE User.DisplayName='Community') * 100

derived.name: PctHighScorePostsByElderUsers
derived.definition: Among posts with score > 5, percentage owned by users older than 65.
aliases: percentage of high score posts by elder users
derived.formula: COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostScore>5 AND UserAge>65) / COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostScore>5) * 100

derived.name: PctHighScorePostsByTopUser
derived.definition: Percentage of posts by the highest-reputation user that have score > 50.
aliases: percentage of posts with score above 50 by most influential
derived.formula: COUNT(Post.Id WHERE PostScore>50 AND UserReputation=MAX(UserReputation)) / COUNT(Post.Id WHERE UserReputation=MAX(UserReputation)) * 100
